declarations.title: Name & complete address of manufacturer / packer / importer
declarations.detectionHint: Look for a prefix like 'Mfd by / Manufactured by / Marketed by / Packed by / Imported by' plus a 6-digit Indian PIN code nearby as a proxy for a full address.

declarations.title: Common or generic name of the commodity
declarations.detectionHint: Best-effort only: treat the largest/first prominent text block as the product name. Mark 'Manual review' rather than hard-failing when uncertain — this is inherently fuzzy.

declarations.title: Net quantity in standard units (weight / volume / number)
declarations.detectionHint: A number immediately followed by a standard unit.

declarations.title: Maximum Retail Price, inclusive of all taxes, to 2 decimal places
declarations.detectionHint: Currency symbol/keyword followed by a number. Also soft-check for the phrase 'inclusive of all taxes' nearby (warn, don't hard-fail, if missing).

declarations.title: Month & year of manufacture / packing / import
Name, address, phone & email for consumer grievances
Country of origin / assembly (imported goods only)
